description: Keep a backup (kept: true) out of rotation until it is unkept: retention and a snapshot's 72-hour expiry leave it, and it can't be deleted until unkept (deleting the server still deletes it). Up to 3 per server; kept backups count toward the server's backup space, so keeping a daily backup is refused when it would leave no room for the next safety snapshot. kept: false puts it back into rotation, where the server's next daily, manual or scheduled backup may delete it.
name: set_backup_kept
